title: Kim Chiu’s sister’s bail reduced to P5.6 million
summary: A Quezon City court has 'partially granted' the camp’s motion to reduce the P5.8 million bail for TV host-actress Kim Chiu’s older sister Lakambini, the accused’s lawyer said Tuesday.
